title: Blood returns from the lungs
hook: Trace one part of the circulation.

knows: The heart has atria and ventricles.
doesNotKnow: Pulmonary veins carry oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium. Veins are named by their direction toward the heart, not by oxygen content.

misconception: Blood passes randomly between the four chambers.
objective: Trace the specified step in normal mammalian circulation.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: Pulmonary veins return oxygenated blood from the lungs to which heart chamber? Pulmonary veins carry oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium.
